metadata.family: Independent shared response for each physical bank x string, one signed force per crossing; equal-pitch bank contributions sum in mono.
metadata.fit_scope: Same supplied 47.624807256s mono recording; in-sample fitting, no independent validation, no source mixing or authenticity/biomechanical feasibility claim.
metadata.geometry_assumptions: Two ordered 21-string banks B 0..20, A 26..46, nonsounding six-spacing gap; 21+21 D-pentatonic tuning hypothetical. Full 42 points retained, only inherited six-pitch modal dictionary excited.
metadata.initial_state: One complex state per observed mode per five recording-resume intervals, tau=1.5s; aggregate initial state not assigned arbitrarily to a bank.
metadata.prior_version_caveat: v6 was A-only. v4/v5 allowed interior reversals/stops. v6/v7 reset ringing at recording gaps; v4/v5 masked gaps but let old contacts decay after resume.
metadata.search_bound_change: Maximum speed remains 50 string-spacings/s. Max half-cycle expanded explicitly from v6 0.9s to v7 2.0s so larger spans can be traversed slowly. Not video-calibrated.

route.orientation_definition: +1 pitch index rises with spatial coordinate; -1 falls. Not measured from video.
route.route_objective: sum log(1+normalized_onset_drive^2) at modeled geometric crossings minus disclosed sweep and duration penalties
route.observation_status: Only two-bank order/facing edges are visually supported. 21+21 points, spacing, tuning, orientation, span and reach are hypotheses.
route.silence_handling: One continuous analytic trajectory through all recording gaps. Gap events disabled. Contact ringing resets at recording silence; one initial state per observed pitch/mode per resume.
route.unmodeled_strings: All 42 spatial points are retained. Crossed strings outside the inherited six-pitch dictionary are explicitly assumed to have zero effective pluck. Gap 20..26 has no sound source.
